subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Payments trial planning
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Payments trial planning

Hi Miguel / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciate the time. As promised, here’s a short recap of the proposed POC scope, measurable success criteria, timeline, and next steps so we’re all aligned before we lock the kickoff date.

POC overview (4-week trial)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Atlas's payments assistant flows (authorization queries + reconciliation summarization).
- Environment: Dedicated trial capacity (single-region, us-east) with masked sample data.
- Owners: Jordan (AE) — commercial/coordination, Marissa (CS) — technical onboarding & evals, Laura (Solutions Eng) — infra/latency tuning.

Success criteria / KPIs (pass/fail thresholds)
- Latency: 95th percentile latency under 200ms for 1-token warm requests, 95th < 350ms for 256-token responses.
- Throughput: Sustained 50 inference requests/sec with <10% tail latency degradation during burst tests (2x traffic for 10s).
- Cost: Effective cost <= $0.0006 per input token (target $0.0005/token) across the trial.
- Quality: Automated eval on the 250-sample test set: >= 90% accuracy on intent classification and >= 85% ROUGE-L for summary tasks.
- Reliability: No more than one 5-minute downtime incident during trial; successful fallbacks for any degraded nodes.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): Data sample delivery from Atlas (anonymized CSV), environment access, and baseline metric capture.
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests.
- Week 2: Load tests (throughput & burst), latency tuning.
- Week 3: Quality evals with labeled set.
- Week 4: Joint review + decision (go/no-go) and handoff plan.

Deliverables
- Redwood: POC runbook, metrics dashboard link, and a 250-sample eval report.
- Atlas: Labeled eval set, expected traffic profile, and decision criteria sign-off.

Next steps (action items)
1) Miguel/Priya: share anonymized sample data and traffic profile by EOD Friday (10/30).
2) Jordan/Marissa: send the POC runbook and invite for kickoff (propose 11/2).
3) Laura: provision trial capacity and share dashboard link.

Attachments: Redwood POC plan (redwood-poc-plan.pdf) and the sample data schema (atlas-sample-data-schema.csv).

If that looks right, we’ll schedule the kickoff for Monday 11/2 at 10am ET.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0172

---
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@atlas-payments.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Payments trial planning

Jordan —

This is great, thanks for the clear plan and KPIs. A few quick notes from our side:

- Sample data: we can provide a masked CSV with ~300 rows (transactions + metadata) by Friday 10/30. We'll remove any PII.
- Quality thresholds: 90% intent accuracy is reasonable for most flows; for reconciliation summaries we may need to agree on tolerance for numeric rounding (I'll add a couple example edge-cases).
- Security: our security team will need the SOC2 report and the data retention policy for the trial environment — can you provide the SOC2 cert and the short doc on logs/retention?
- Sizing: 50 rps looks high for our baseline but good to validate burst behavior. We can narrow the expected sustained rate after we share the traffic profile.

We’re OK with a 4-week cadence. Monday 11/2 at 10am ET works for a kickoff. Please include our security lead if possible (I'll loop them in once the kickoff is scheduled).

-Miguel
Head of Product Ops | Atlas Payments
miguel.santos@atlas-payments.com
